{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check balance of key covariates between treatment and control groups
# Cross-tabulate arm with site, sex, and severity to check for imbalances
covariates = ['site', 'sex', 'severity']

for covariate in covariates:
    cross_tab = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data[covariate], margins=True)
    print(f"\nCross-tabulation of arm vs {covariate}:")
    print(cross_tab)
    
    # Check if proportions are similar
    treatment_prop = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment'][covariate].value_counts(normalize=True)
    control_prop = data[data['arm'] == 'control'][covariate].value_counts(normalize=True)
    
    # Compare proportions
    if not treatment_prop.index.equals(control_prop.index):
        print(f"  WARNING: Different categories in {covariate} between arms")
    else:
        diff = (treatment_prop - control_prop).abs().max()
        print(f"  Max absolute difference in {covariate} proportions: {diff:.4f}")"}
